Privacy

This website is a set of static pages. It sets no cookies and runs no analytics. The videos on the evolution page are played from Google Drive, which may set its own cookies when you play one. If you email us, we keep your message to reply to it.

Photographs of people on this site were taken at SeaBrick events. If you appear in one and would like it removed, write to us.

A nonprofit research society building low-cost, carbon-negative floating infrastructure for coastal communities facing rising seas.
